## Evidence and scope

<a id="er-0001-f01"></a>
### ER-0001-F01 — Completion has meaning within a declared scope

[Report section](reports/001-vandeir-silva.md#er-0001-f01) · Comparison: `reviewed` · Independent validation: `pending_validation`.

Source: [answer 10](reports/001-vandeir-silva.md#er-0001-q10) in the embedded interview.

> The customer's actual resolution, whether in a current account, credit card, remittance to another institution or remittance to the Federal Revenue Service, was the responsibility of other partner departments.

**[CORE-002.1](../../docs/coreDoc/core-doc.md#core-0021-lifecycle-changes-require-a-declared-valid-transition) — supports the rationale.** Distinguishing local completion from the customer-facing effect supports declaring the meaning and conditions of a state.

**Scope.** The account does not define FinKore transitions or universal payment-finality criteria. Settlement remains outside the Core scope.

<a id="er-0001-f02"></a>
### ER-0001-F02 — Relevant conditions must be checked before a result becomes observable

[Report section](reports/001-vandeir-silva.md#er-0001-f02) · Comparison: `reviewed` · Independent validation: `pending_validation`.

Source: [answer 4](reports/001-vandeir-silva.md#er-0001-q04) in the embedded interview.

> The amount was not remitted because of a system failure: the system had not been configured to accept a standalone payment document for such a large amount.

**[CORE-002.2](../../docs/coreDoc/core-doc.md#core-0022-validation-is-complete-fact-based-and-non-mutating) — illustrates the risk.** Initial confirmation without remittance illustrates the risk of recognizing a result before evaluating eligibility against the relevant facts.

**Scope.** The amount and channel policy belongs to the product. The technical cause and prior existence of the rule were not verified by inspecting the system.

<a id="er-0001-f03"></a>
### ER-0001-F03 — Later recovery does not replace preservation on rejection

[Report section](reports/001-vandeir-silva.md#er-0001-f03) · Comparison: `reviewed` · Independent validation: `pending_validation`.

Source: [answer 9](reports/001-vandeir-silva.md#er-0001-q09) in the embedded interview.

> When an attempt to resolve an issue failed, the accounting balances and account ledger obtained the next day made it possible to identify balances from earlier movements.

**[CORE-002.3](../../docs/coreDoc/core-doc.md#core-0023-rejected-actions-have-no-partial-financial-effect) — illustrates the risk.** Investigating differences after failures illustrates the cost of partial effects and the reason a domain rejection must preserve its specified state.

**Scope.** No FinKore rejection or violation was established. The rule does not guarantee distributed atomicity or generic handling of communication failures.

<a id="er-0001-f04"></a>
### ER-0001-F04 — Identity connects evidence and distinguishes operations

[Report section](reports/001-vandeir-silva.md#er-0001-f04) · Comparison: `reviewed` · Independent validation: `pending_validation`.

Source: [answer 12](reports/001-vandeir-silva.md#er-0001-q12) in the embedded interview.

> In those cases, we checked the teller journal, the document's numeric payment code and the remittance system to establish how many times the amount had been remitted.

**[CORE-005.1](../../docs/coreDoc/core-doc.md#core-0051-continuing-financial-subjects-retain-stable-identity) — supports the rationale.** Reconstructing attempts and remittances supports the practical value of stable subjects to which evidence can be associated.

**Scope.** The bank identifier model was not examined. Entity and Audit Event identities do not establish economic deduplication or an idempotency protocol.

<a id="er-0001-f05"></a>
### ER-0001-F05 — Distinct evolution needs declared meaning and a link to the earlier fact

[Report section](reports/001-vandeir-silva.md#er-0001-f05) · Comparison: `reviewed` · Independent validation: `pending_validation`.

Source: [answer 16](reports/001-vandeir-silva.md#er-0001-q16) in the embedded interview.

> However, when an inconsistency or failure was identified, an accounting reversal entry was made: an inverse adjustment respecting the accounting accounts and cost centers involved.

**[CORE-003.3](../../docs/coreDoc/core-doc.md#core-0033-corrections-and-related-evolution-preserve-original-facts) — supports the rationale.** Resolution through another movement, together with the distinctions in answer 13, supports preserving the origin and making the later action explicit.

**Scope.** Institutional terms do not automatically map to Correction, Reversal, Void or Supersession. The Core does not define concrete accounting postings.

<a id="er-0001-f06"></a>
### ER-0001-F06 — An adjustment needs to remain linked to its original

[Report section](reports/001-vandeir-silva.md#er-0001-f06) · Comparison: `reviewed` · Independent validation: `pending_validation`.

Source: [answer 14](reports/001-vandeir-silva.md#er-0001-q14) in the embedded interview.

> What identified and linked the cases was the description of the adjustment entry.

**[CORE-003.3](../../docs/coreDoc/core-doc.md#core-0033-corrections-and-related-evolution-preserve-original-facts) — supports the rationale.** Using a description to relate the outstanding item to its resolution supports the practical need for a verifiable link to the original.

**Scope.** The answer does not establish additional identifiers or a portable immutable relationship. Free text evidences the need; it does not demonstrate that every requirement was implemented.

<a id="er-0001-f07"></a>
### ER-0001-F07 — Approval has an identifiable subject and financial content

[Report section](reports/001-vandeir-silva.md#er-0001-f07) · Comparison: `reviewed` · Independent validation: `pending_validation`.

Source: [answer 15](reports/001-vandeir-silva.md#er-0001-q15) in the embedded interview.

> I prepared a single file containing all the accounting adjustments, identifying the accounts involved, cost centers, amounts and descriptions.

**[CORE-004.1](../../docs/coreDoc/core-doc.md#core-0041-approval-requirements-state-subject-eligibility-and-outcome) — supports the rationale.** The batch presented to management illustrates a decision about an identified subject and financial content, distinct from technical access to a system.

**Scope.** Eligibility policy and the subject model were not examined. The account does not determine per-item approval, quorum or a universal chain.

**[CORE-004.3](../../docs/coreDoc/core-doc.md#core-0043-decisions-remain-tied-to-their-facts-and-history) — supports the rationale.** The accounts, amounts and descriptions presented for approval support associating a decision with what was actually decided.

**Scope.** Answer 16 concerns entries already processed and does not document changes between approval and execution. It does not demonstrate revalidation after facts change or immutable preservation of the complete decision.

<a id="er-0001-f09"></a>
### ER-0001-F09 — Attribution supports reconstruction of requests and authorizations

[Report section](reports/001-vandeir-silva.md#er-0001-f09) · Comparison: `reviewed` · Independent validation: `pending_validation`.

Source: [answer 17](reports/001-vandeir-silva.md#er-0001-q17) in the embedded interview.

> who requested it and when, as well as who authorized it and when.

**[CORE-003.1](../../docs/coreDoc/core-doc.md#core-0031-a-committed-event-preserves-essential-evidence) — supports the rationale.** Recording responsible people, times and adjustment information supports attributing and reconstructing financial events.

**Scope.** The answer does not demonstrate every portable field, stable identities or immutable history. Automated execution must not be attributed by inference to the human approver.

<a id="er-0001-f11"></a>
### ER-0001-F11 — Evaluations need to identify relevant external facts

[Report section](reports/001-vandeir-silva.md#er-0001-f11) · Comparison: `reviewed` · Independent validation: `pending_validation`.

Source: [answer 19](reports/001-vandeir-silva.md#er-0001-q19) in the embedded interview.

> The cash transport company sent us the cash transport document, or GTV. After that, the branch employee recorded the outflow of funds, resolving the outstanding item.

**[CORE-005.3](../../docs/coreDoc/core-doc.md#core-0053-evaluation-follows-declared-facts-and-context) — supports the rationale.** Consulting external evidence to explain the discrepancy supports identifying facts relevant to an outcome rather than inferring them from authorization or a local balance.

**Scope.** The account does not demonstrate determinism of a FinKore evaluation. A consistent evaluation does not certify the material truth of external information or establish exception policy.

## Maintenance

Edit only `traceability.json.curation`. The remaining JSON and this page are generated. Changes to a report, its embedded interview, excerpt locations or CoreDoc clauses require reassessment; rebuilding does not approve changed bindings.

Bindings retain paths, anchors, evidence roles and fingerprints for later editorial selection alongside rules. Analyst assessment is separate from publication authorization.
